$description: Everyday Eats design tokens v3.0 (1 Oct 2026). Palette: Clean warm. Type: Schibsted Grotesk, one family for everything. Three tiers: primitives, semantic tokens, component tokens. Screens use semantic or component tokens only. W3C Design Tokens format. The source of truth for values; not imported anywhere yet.

500.$description: 4.6:1 on Cream; white text on it 5.0:1. Do not make brighter or more saturated.
Nutrition set, not brand. 5.5:1 on Card
Nutrition set, not brand. 4.1:1 on Card: graphics only
Nutrition set, not brand. 3.0:1 on Card, 2.9:1 on Cream: graphics on Card only, never text, never lighter

700.$description: Warning (reserved). Renamed from amber so it no longer clashes with the nutrition amber

raised.$description: Sheets, snackbars, inputs, tab and action bars, nutrition panel, bookmark button

sunken.$description: Search field, info note, photo placeholders, disabled button, empty-state icon circle

highlight.$description: Search-match highlight behind the matched term, always with an underline so it never relies on colour alone

hover.$description: Desktop only (reserved). Not used in the mobile app.

pressed.$description: Laid over tappable containers (cards, action rows) when pressed

on-action.$description: Text and icons on primary buttons

on-accent.$description: Text on Terracotta 50 (selected chip, cooking-style tag)

accent.$description: Active tab, saved bookmark, selected radio, action-row arrow

accent-secondary.$description: Reserved. Herb is an accent, never a second primary

primary-hover.$description: Desktop only (reserved). Not used in the mobile app.

subtle.$description: Card, chip and panel outlines, list dividers, top bar and tab bar edges

default.$description: Text inputs, outlined buttons, unselected radio ring (3:1 boundary)

focus.$description: Keyboard focus (:focus-visible) and the field being typed in: a 2px Ink outline, 2px outside the element. Never shown after tapping a button. Ink reads on Cream (15.8:1) and on terracotta fills (3.4:1)

protein.$description: Dots and bar segments on Card only

carbs.$description: Dots and bar segments on Card only

fat.$description: Dots and bar segments on Card only; at the 3:1 graphics minimum

nutrition.$description: Label data, never judge it. Separate from the brand palette. Colour is never the only signal: every segment has a named legend row with its value.

error.$description: Failed actions and invalid input only, always with icon and message

color.$description: Primitives (neutral, terracotta, herb, berry, blue, amber, red, ochre, ink-alpha) hold raw values. Semantic groups (surface, overlay, text, icon, action, border, nutrition, feedback) say what a colour is for; components and screens use only these.

base.$description: The only typeface: headings, body, UI, labels and every number (numbers with tabular figures). Google Fonts, weights 400, 500 and 600. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and tracking.

tabular.$description: Tabular figures for all nutrition values

display.$description: Reserved; onboarding is out of v1

1.$description: Screen titles (including "Everyday Eats" on Home), recipe name on detail

2.$description: Section titles, featured card title, the Ingredients and What’s in it headings

3.$description: Option card and sheet titles, the empty-state title when nothing is saved yet, recipe name in Today’s pick. Recipe cards use component.card.title

title.$description: Home action-row titles, the empty-state title for no results and the empty builder

small.$description: Chips, tags, tab labels (600 when active)

overline.$description: Category above a recipe title, section labels ("Start checking") in Walnut. On nutrition search, the result group labels ("Dishes", "Packaged products") use color.action.primary (Terracotta 500) so the groups stand out. Never on a result itself

s.$description: Values in chips and compact labels (13/16 500). List and card calories use their own component styles: component.list-row.value and component.card.kcal

typography.$description: One family, Schibsted Grotesk. Headings are weight 500 with slight negative tracking from 24px up; body, UI and every number use the same family, numbers with tabular figures. Headings balance their lines (text-wrap: balance). Line heights follow the type, not the 4px grid.

unit.$description: Unit beside a number (“18 g”, “194 kcal”), in Walnut. Its own 16px line box, so the number’s line height holds: macro rows stay 24px, list values 22px

tight.$description: Icon to label, number to unit

card.$description: Recipe card text block: 12px on every side, so card text lands on the 20px text line (8px grid inset + 12px)

inset.$description: Two-column recipe grid: 8px from the screen edge (the grid extends 12px into the 20px screen margin)

space.$description: 4px base, 8px rhythm. Every padding, margin, gap, offset and component size is a multiple of 4.

lg.$description: Recipe cards (the card clips its image), option cards, action rows, nutrition panel, Today’s pick photo

full.$description: Bookmark button, radios, empty-state circle, Home action-row icon circle. No pill-shaped buttons or chips

default.$description: Every border, including the selected chip

ring.$description: An outline 2px outside the element’s edge, following its corners. One colour everywhere, including the primary button

1.$description: Tab bar and action bar (cast upwards); bookmark circle over a photo

2.$description: Bottom sheets; snackbars together with elevation.1 (component.snackbar.shadow)

chip-check.$description: Check inside a selected chip only

icon.$description: Phosphor Regular with round caps and joins. The same visible 1.5px stroke at every size (on the 256 grid: 16 at 24px, 19.2 at 20px, 24 at 16px). Fill weight only for selected or active states.

placeholder.$description: Dish icon centred in a recipe image placeholder

image.$description: Crops. Real food photography only; no text or UI on photos.

recipe-card.$description: Recipe and editorial cards, including the featured card

recipe-hero.$description: Recipe hero under the top bar: the 4:5 crop, shown full width at 390 × 320

home-hero.$description: Today’s pick photo on Home, 160 × 120, radius lg

thumbnail.$description: Reserved: ingredient and product thumbnails (not on current screens)

standard.$description: Gentle ease-out; instant when reduce-motion is on

component.$description: Component tokens alias semantic or primitive tokens. Components use these instead of hardcoded values.

selected.$description: The save control in its on state (Saved): Terracotta 50 fill, 1px Terracotta 500 border, Terracotta 700 text and a filled bookmark, so the state never relies on colour alone

amount-unit-height.$description: Amount field: the unit chips take the number input's height (48) and radius (radius.md) so the two read as one control family, aligned on one line. The input fills the rest of the row and is always the wider part; the unit chips keep their natural width

amount-gap.$description: Between the Amount and Unit columns

clear-size.$description: Hairline circle holding a 16px X, inside a 44px target

height.$description: Visual height, inside a 44px tap area

gap.$description: Between chips and between check and label

min-width.$description: Short labels like "g" still get a 44px-wide target

tag.$description: One tag component with two colour variants (diet, style). Tags appear only when they apply and are never added to fill space: 0 or 1 on a recipe card (the most useful one), no empty tag space, all applicable tags on recipe detail

card.$description: One frame, no nested padding. The hairline is an inside stroke that takes no space, the 3:2 image fills the card’s width and the card’s radius clips its top corners. Text block: overline, title, then at most one tag and the kcal line, always last

background.$description: Sits on Cream with a hairline

border-style.$description: 1px outline drawn inside the edge (outline-offset −1px); takes no layout space

bookmark-offset.$description: The 44px bookmark target sits 4px in, so its 36px circle is 8px from the card edges

title.$description: Recipe card title in the two-column grid: 18/24 500, balanced lines, one step below Heading 3 so long names stay within three lines. The featured card uses Heading 2

kcal.$description: Calorie number on recipe cards and Today’s pick: 13/18 500, tabular, Ink; the words “kcal per serving” are Body small in Walnut

underline.$description: Underline in the text colour, 3px offset

search-match.$description: Every occurrence of the search term in recipe search results; an ingredient match is named under the title (“With lemon zest”)

gap.$description: Minimum space between the title and “See all”. A title that doesn’t fit wraps instead of crowding the link. On Home, “See all” has no caret, so “Quick weeknight dinners” fits on one line

arrow.$description: The only colour in the row

size.$description: The icon of the tab the job belongs to: Leaf (Check nutrition), Book (Find a recipe)

color.$description: Ink; the arrow stays the only colour in the row

bookmark.$description: The compact save control and the only way to save a recipe: recipe cards and the Recipe detail photo; also removes a dish in My dishes rows. Outline bookmark in Ink when not saved, Fill in Terracotta 500 when saved. No label, no terracotta fill, so it stays secondary to the food

photo-offset.$description: Recipe detail: the 44px target sits 8px into the photo’s top-right corner (its circle 12px in), with elevation.1 on the circle

top-bar.$description: Back is the arrow alone in a 44px target, 8px from the screen edge. Its accessible name says where it goes (“Back to search results”). No text, no centred title: the screen title is an H1 in the content

content-bottom-padding.$description: Scrolling content clears the tab bar

tab-bar.$description: Four tabs: Home, Eat, Recipes, Profile. Active: Fill icon, Terracotta 500, label weight 600, aria-current. Screens under a tab keep it active: Saved recipes, My dishes and Settings keep Profile active

background.$description: Card, neutral for saved and removed alike; lighter than the Cream page so the snackbar stands off it

border.$description: 1px Hairline inside stroke (no size change), the same as cards

shadow.$description: elevation.1 and elevation.2 stacked: a slightly clearer lift than a sheet, so it never blends into the page

text.$description: Message and bookmark icon in Ink; Undo uses color.action.primary (Terracotta 500) and is the only accent

bottom.$description: 16px above the 84px tab bar. Above the action bar on results: 112px (component.snackbar.bottom-action-bar). On screens with neither, like Recipe detail: 40px, 16px above the 24px safe area (component.snackbar.bottom-no-bar)

bottom-action-bar.$description: 16px above the 96px action bar (dish and custom dish results)

bottom-no-bar.$description: 16px above the 24px safe area, on screens without a tab bar or action bar (Recipe detail)

background.$description: Macro colours are contrast-checked on Card

row-height.$description: Each legend row (dot, name, value + unit). The value is Number M (17/24); the unit uses typography.unit so the row stays 24px

empty-state.$description: One component: an Oat circle with a 24px Ink icon (never terracotta), a centred title over one Body line in Walnut, and one terracotta primary button. When a screen or a search has nothing to show, the group is centred in the content area between the 56px top bar and the 84px tab bar and keeps its own spacing. The empty builder (Build a dish) sits in its flow, 24px below the Ingredients heading, with no button: the outlined Add ingredient button follows it

nothing-saved.$description: Saved recipes (Find a recipe) and My dishes (Check nutrition)

no-results.$description: Recipe search and Saved recipes search (Clear search), nutrition search (Build your own); also the empty builder, without a button

todays-pick.$description: Compact editorial recommendation on Home: Overline label, then a row with a 4:3 photo (160 × 120) beside the H3 recipe name and one meta line (time, servings, calories). The whole block is one link to the recipe; no button or arrow.

recipe-hero.$description: Prominent food hero on Recipe detail. Much larger than Today’s pick, but not most of the screen.

height.$description: The 4:5 crop shown full width at 390 × 320: clearly larger than Today’s pick, but the title, meta and nutrition summary come into the first viewport

value.$description: Calorie value in breakdown rows, search results and My dishes: 15/22 600, tabular; unit (“kcal”) in typography.unit, Walnut

save-control.$description: The labelled save toggle for dishes: both dish results, in the action bar. Not saved: primary style, outline bookmark, “Save”. Saved: component.button.selected with a filled bookmark and “Saved”. aria-pressed; each tap shows the snackbar with Undo. Recipes use component.bookmark instead

nav-row.$description: Profile rows that open another screen: title (Body) over one Walnut line, a 20px caret in Walnut. Grouped under an Overline (Saved, App). Hairline between rows, none after the last

value-row.$description: Read-only label and value, value in Walnut on the right (Settings › Account: name and email)
